notes: Software development for multiple mobile robot systems and mobile transport robots in intralogistics. Work spans vehicle software and central fleet control, product development and customer projects. Requirements emphasize C++, Linux, ROS or related frameworks, sensor fusion, localization, navigation, control, hardware components, machine learning/AI, user-interface tooling, Git/GitLab and Docker. timeline.description: Job added to dashboard as open with high priority.

notes: Software engineering for real-time computer vision systems running on embedded NVIDIA Jetson hardware on vessels. Role focuses on C++/Python processing pipelines, real-time performance optimization, memory/compute/latency constraints, unit/integration/end-to-end testing, and cross-functional hardware/AI development. Requires hands-on GStreamer/video pipeline experience and lists 5+ years of production software experience. Nice-to-have technologies include NVIDIA DeepStream, Jetson/JetPack, OpenCV, CUDA/TensorRT, multi-object tracking, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and machine learning. Minimum salary EUR 60,000 gross per year.

notes: Software engineering for Hitachi Rail's Dependable Systems team and TAS platform, a safety-critical real-time hardware and software platform for railway applications. Responsibilities include safety-, real-time- and security-focused software development, distributed systems and protocols, complex-system analysis, technical architecture and design, design patterns, implementation/integration/verification, and working in an agile environment with standardized quality and safety processes.
